study.title: Coringa / Godavari delta, Andhra Pradesh
study.question: Do surface-water and vegetation signals in the Coringa mangrove creeks differ between seasonally matched 2020 and 2025 observations, and how far can a masked NDVI difference be trusted at this tidal site?
phenomena: surface water extent in tidal creeks
limitations: Tidal stage and turbidity are uncontrolled confounders.

properties.source: Manually placed over the mangrove/creek complex of Coringa Wildlife Sanctuary south of Kakinada; not the official sanctuary boundary.

catalog.license: Copernicus Sentinel data: free, open and unrestricted use with attribution (ESA Copernicus data policy). Catalogue: Element 84 Earth Search, AWS Open Data.

operations: STAC search with AOI polygon and date range
in-AOI SCL valid-fraction scoring and selection
windowed COG read via WarpedVRT (bilinear reflectance, nearest SCL)
common-valid mask intersection across both dates
delta NDVI with thresholded area summary
